posts.text: Congratulations to @Jim_Jordan on being elected House Minority Leader for the 120th Congress! I look forward to working together to strengthen our national defense, support our troops, and fight for hardworking Americans.
It’s great to be back in DeSoto County tonight visiting with our constituents. https://t.co/2hTncXxNcm
Mississippi Young Bankers held their lunch and learn session in Tupelo today. I was honored to discuss ways for these men and women to engage with their representatives. https://t.co/eINzJw79EE
Working in this District, discussing issues that are important to our constituents. https://t.co/PKNuAfDysr
Great night in Pontotoc discussing the issues that are important to our constituents. https://t.co/RrXItMxVjE
Great to see members and guests of the Ripley Rotary Club today and discuss our work on their behalf in Washington, D.C. https://t.co/WvhGSzxzNk
It was great to see friends in Senatobia last night. https://t.co/b1vtuBai3d

Please read my latest newsletter for updates from Mississippi's First Congressional District.

https://t.co/25hIQYDxfD https://t.co/nW2LjGO0z3
Gathered with first responders and residents of Horn Lake to share our memories of 9/11. https://t.co/ls9wuw9h4e

Enjoyed meeting Luke, Andrew, and Amanda Bilbo while in Oxford last night. Luke is interested in attending one of America’s prestigious service academies. To learn more about Service Academy nominees through our office, visit https://t.co/c6ZE68jQxd. https://t.co/xUNnO93c65

It is an honor to be on hallowed ground at the Flight 93 Memorial in Shanksville, Pennsylvania. 25 years ago, the heroic actions of passengers and crew saved countless lives. As we reflect on the lives lost on 9/11, it is vital we do everything in our power to prepare for future https://t.co/uiCS32Yb9m

The passengers and crew of #Flight93 will always be Heroes. Their courage and bravery saved many lives. It was an honor to join my @HouseIntel colleagues for a roundtable discussion with #Flight93 family members of passengers and crew. America will always remember the sacrifices https://t.co/Xc7zgtYH6C

The passengers and crew of #Flight93 will always be Heroes. Their courage and bravery saved lives. It was an honor to join my @HouseIntel colleagues on hallowed ground to pay our respects at the Flight93 Memorial in Shanksville, Pennsylvania. As America reflects on the 25th https://t.co/kG2mq1xOYu

It's always good to be home. I've been traveling across the district meeting with constituents and attending community events.

Read my latest newsletter for updates on the work we've been doing.

https://t.co/FRGrP3AE5f https://t.co/ijOOlBkanS

It was great to be on hand to participate in the grand opening of Aurora Flight Sciences’ major expansion in Columbus. The expansion adds 50,000 square feet to support aerospace production. Additionally, 40,000 square feet of existing space was renovated to accommodate https://t.co/zpxIktIEtf
Appreciated the opportunity to discuss important issues on @supertalk. https://t.co/JntQsK4ej2

I am proud to join Rep. Michael Guest and Rep. Mike Ezell in a letter sent to President Trump expressing our strong support for his legislative efforts to address national defense, agricultural, and election-security priorities. https://t.co/VLiaSc4qJ4

Read my latest newsletter for updates and highlights from Mississippi's First Congressional District.

https://t.co/rkeKgHx2Ez https://t.co/ZLLk3cZLC3

Read my latest newsletter for updates and highlights from Mississippi's First Congressional District and Capitol Hill.

https://t.co/oW72jLOayN https://t.co/4U08J5lP3T

Congratulations to the students who made the Mississippi State Finals of the National Civics Bee! It was an honor to participate in this great event held in Tupelo. Thanks to the CREATE Foundation, U.S. Chamber of Commerce Foundation, parents, teachers, judges, and volunteers. https://t.co/ypdL82WShT
It was an honor to attend the CAFB 14th Flying Training Wing Change of Command Ceremony where Colonel James J. Blech relinquished command to Colonel Joshua D. Jensen. https://t.co/bET2i0OHsK

Coming up in our next newsletter, we will feature Lee County Veteran Service Officer Ashleigh Pharr. The Fulton native devotes herself to serving the needs of veterans and we are thankful for all her hard work and dedication. Team Kelly is honored to work with Ashleigh and all https://t.co/utHDFAOHgq

Please read my latest newsletter for highlights from across Mississippi's First Congressional District.

https://t.co/yqOoPcAXin https://t.co/sEozkTUPoN

Great news for Alcorn County. Keytronic, a global electronics manufacturing services provider, is expanding its operations in Corinth. This investment will create 376 new jobs for hardworking Mississippians, strengthen the local economy, and support continued growth in Northeast https://t.co/EO7r5W9yXU

Great to welcome @OleMiss Chancellor Glenn Boyce, Vice Chancellor of Research and Economic Development John Higginbotham, and Executive Director of Federal Relations Amy Lewis to our D.C. office. https://t.co/6H08j8u3lB
Today we recognize our nation's women veterans who have served with honor to protect the freedoms we cherish every day. Thank you for your service. https://t.co/BGrGFM9qmn

Please read my latest newsletter for updates on the great things happening across Mississippi's First District and on Capitol Hill.

https://t.co/omeUJwFDOc https://t.co/AoXC9mk4Xp

From farmers to small businesses, our state is full of hardworking people doing great things. Read my latest newsletter for highlights from across Mississippi's First Congressional District.

https://t.co/4w13MAU4mg https://t.co/TDWPRcnULJ

Today is Peace Officers Memorial Day. We honor the fallen officers who made the ultimate sacrifice in service to our communities, our state, and our nation. Their courage and sacrifice will never be forgotten as we remember the lives they gave to protect others. https://t.co/BnwadMZEhH
